claims.statement: For the fixed hub-plus-arm sector of CB(8,92), the residual rank-491 and rank-490 families have selected-tag weight ratio 493/491 and weight difference 2W_490/491. This is a deficit only for a boundary whose capacities are confined to the same sector; it does not imply a switch-capacity threshold for the full deletion neighborhood.
claims.scope: The bounded CB(8,92) sector with 736 disjoint support-leaf pairs, residual source rank 491, residual target rank 490, and weight 1 plus the number of selected branch leaves. The graph is eligible at p=492 and has a negative complete selected aggregate. No mixed Hall result or universal ordinary-tree conclusion is established.
claims.reason: Disposition: retained_narrowed. The two exact mass ratios and their difference are correct by integer cross-multiplication. However, the weight includes the fixed arm tag, and deleting that tag leaves the hub-plus-arm sector. Therefore the reported shortfall is not a Hall deficit when all deletion targets are available. Retain only the within-sector capacity comparison; the full deletion and mixed-boundary conclusions remain unproved.

limitations: The sector weight comparison does not include deletion targets outside the fixed hub-plus-arm sector.
The conservative CB switch-cut envelope is inconclusive and is not an exact Hall neighborhood or flow.
The bounded CB replay has a negative complete aggregate and neither proves nor refutes the universal ordinary-tree assertion.
